## Health

In terms of health status and health services, one in ten participants reported living with HIV - the overwhelming majority were virally suppressed (see @tbl-health). In addition, about 16% reported at least one STI symptom. Two out of five participants were on PrEP at the time they took the survey. Two-thirds had received the MPOX vaccine, though only 8% had received MPOX testing.
